name: music_effects
description: Sound check: verify each audio effect works — baseline then effect, listen for the change
script: strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 cps=0.5 lpf=400
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 cps=0.5 lpf=1500
strudel [c3 e3 g3 c4]*2 cps=0.5 hpf=600
strudel c4 ~ e4 ~ g4 ~ c5 ~ cps=0.4
announce 3/7: REVERB — room=0.8 (should ring out, spacious)
strudel c4 ~ e4 ~ g4 ~ c5 ~ cps=0.4 room=0.8
strudel c4 ~ e4 ~ g4 ~ c5 ~ cps=0.4 room=0.3
strudel [c3 e3 g3 c4]*2 cps=0.5 distort=0.5
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 cps=0.5 crush=4
announce 8/11: ADSR BASELINE — default envelope (instant attack/release)
strudel edit note("c4 e4 g4 c5").pianoroll() cps=0.3
announce 9/11: ADSR ATTACK — .attack(0.5) should fade in slowly
strudel edit note("c4 e4 g4 c5").attack(0.5).pianoroll() cps=0.3
announce 10/11: ADSR RELEASE — .release(1.0) should ring out after note ends
strudel edit note("c4 e4 g4 c5").release(1.0).pianoroll() cps=0.3
strudel edit note("c3 e3 g3 c4").attack(0.3).decay(0.1).sustain(0.5).release(0.8).pianoroll() cps=0.25
notify {SCRIPT} "Did effects and ADSR sound correct?" ["All good","Some issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
